body: Measured R11 path surface on committed HEAD 9a29cd53, excluding dirty working copies. The public resolver defect is acquire/resolve.scala:333-346, where evidence is first-wins distinctBy evidenceId. But an acquire-only repair would leave three authority doors open: core/claim.scala:29-35 exposes public case-class Evidence with caller-selected EvidenceId; codec/core.scala:224-229 decodes that id and content directly; document/compiler.scala:481-518 performs the ById/Inline ledger join, while five Resolver.resolve call sites are merely order-guarded by private canonicalBundle at 736-772 and accepted evidence is materialized at 1298/1337-1342. Existing courts are acquire ProposalSuite/ResolveSuite, core ClaimSuite plus ConstructionProbeSuite, codec CodecSuite/CodecGens, and document CompilerSuite. Recommendation for the bead: do not scope R11 to resolve.scala alone; name the admitted Evidence identity/content relation and ledger join first, then make identity conflict or unverifiable ById/Inline equivalence yield typed Unresolved and refuse canonical projection/admission witness. Exact public names still await your type-review ruling. No edit, claim, vocabulary, or reservation.
